description: Source code for V4L2 VP8 video decoder delegate, including functions for submitting decode commands and outputting pictures, as well as class definitions for VP8 pictures and the decoder delegate.

classes.name: V4L2VP8Picture
classes.description: Represents a VP8 picture with an associated V4L2 decode surface.

classes.name: V4L2VideoDecoderDelegateVP8
classes.description: Delegate class for handling VP8 decoding via V4L2 interface.

methods.name: CreateVP8Picture
methods.description: Creates a new VP8 picture with an associated decode surface.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Submits a VP8 picture for decoding, setting up necessary controls and references.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded VP8 picture, signaling readiness.

methods.name: VP8PictureToV4L2DecodeSurface
methods.description: Converts a VP8 picture to its associated V4L2 decode surface.
